title: Page
description: Shared cursor-based pagination block returned with every list response (PRP-01 clarification 15). The root schema is the response-side page; $defs/cursor is the opaque cursor a client echoes back on the next request. Cursors are server-issued and server-signed; a cursor that fails signature or scope binding is rejected as invalid_schema (behaviour in PRP-05, not expressible here). Not a standalone document, so it carries no schema_version. has_more=false with next_cursor non-null is rejected by the schema; returned <= limit is checked by tests/contracts/validators.py::check_page_counts.

limit.description: Effective limit applied by the server after clamping the requested Budget.limit.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when has_more is false.

truncated.description: True when a budget other than limit stopped the result early (partial result, must be labelled in the UI).

truncation_reason.description: Which budget stopped the result. Required when truncated is true.

cursor.description: Opaque, server-signed, base64url cursor. It encodes position only, never query text or filters, and is bound server-side to the caller's IdentityScope.
